new_feature_requests.summary: Add a simple live picks page
Add a simple Live Picks page at route "/live" that requires Internet Identity login and displays live picks in a responsive card grid.
On the Live Picks page, include basic controls: a text search (player name/team) and a simple status filter (All/Live/Final/Upcoming) that work together to filter the visible picks.
Fetch Live Picks data from the backend with periodic polling and show standard loading/error states, plus a "Last updated" timestamp when available.
Ensure the backend exposes the Live Picks read APIs needed by the Live Picks page: getLivePicks(), getLivePicksLastUpdated(), and getLivePicksDiagnostics().

projectName: Add a simple Live Picks page
